evidence.Medial Meniscus: Complex tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with both radial and horizontal components.
evidence.Medial OA: Degenerative changes in the medial tibiofemoral and patellofemoral compartments as described.
evidence.Lateral OA: Relatively well-maintained hyaline articular cartilage in the lateral tibiofemoral compartment.
evidence.PF OA: Low-grade chondral thinning and minor bone stress changes noted along the median patellar rate and medial retropatellar facet.
evidence.Baker's: Multi loculated ganglion cyst encasing the popliteus tendon
